learning_outcomes.text: Knows the fundamental concepts of innovative entrepreneurship, including types of innovation, the innovation lifecycle, and their role in the automotive industry.
Understands the operating mechanisms of the automotive market and the impact of economic, technological, and environmental factors on the development of innovative products and services.
Knows the stages of the entrepreneurial process, from identifying a business opportunity in the field of road vehicles to drafting a viable business plan.
Understands the principles of innovation management applied in the design, production, and commercialization of modern vehicles (electric, autonomous, intelligent).
Knows digital tools and emerging technologies (e.g., artificial intelligence, IoT, sustainable mobility) that can generate competitive advantages in the automotive sector.
Understands the importance of ethics, sustainability, and social responsibility in the development and implementation of innovative entrepreneurial initiatives in the transport sector.
Identifies and evaluates innovative business opportunities in the field of automotive and smart mobility.
Develops and argues a business plan for an innovative product or service in the automotive sector, integrating technical, economic, and sustainable aspects.
Applies innovation management principles in the development of technological solutions for ecological, electric, or autonomous vehicles.
Uses digital tools and modern applications for market analysis, product design, and project management in technological entrepreneurship.
Evaluates the risks and critical success factors of an entrepreneurial initiative in the automotive industry.
Collaborates efficiently in multidisciplinary teams, contributing to the conception and implementation of innovative projects.

Respects ethical principles, norms, and values in the correct and timely execution of professional tasks, by adopting a rigorous, efficient, and responsible work strategy in decision-making for problem-solving.
Integrates into the working group and applies effective relationship-building and teamwork techniques in multidisciplinary teams, at various hierarchical levels.
Continuously informs and documents themselves in their field of activity by adequately using effective lifelong learning methods and techniques.
Develops professional projects in the field of engineering.

syllabus_topics: Subject of study of the discipline
Introduction to entrepreneurship. Entrepreneur's profile and skills. Principles of personal management. Career strategies.
Business laws. Identifying business ideas. Validating business ideas. Business people's skills. Creating an entrepreneurial attitude.
Notions of economics and economic counseling.
Notions of business legislation and legal counseling.
Notions regarding starting a business. Elements of protecting a business idea (patenting, trademark registration, logo, etc.). Identifying necessary resources.
Notions regarding business planning and management. Business establishment. Business plan.
Identifying business financing opportunities. Business financing.
Concept of entrepreneurship. Necessity of entrepreneurship. Entrepreneurial characteristics. Creating a culture for innovative entrepreneurship. Laws of sales. Sales strategies.
Necessity of innovation. Barriers and risks of innovation. Innovative projects. Innovative organizations. Business development strategies.
Setting personal goals (specific, positive, SMART and identifying necessary resources)
Developing a career strategy. Preparing a CURRICULUM VITAE.

assessment_methods.method: Systematic observation of students (individual/team assignments, preparation of a case study report) for the exam part
Final summative evaluation test for the exam part

assessment_rules: The final evaluation result is determined by considering the scores and weights assigned to each activity. Grades range from 1 to 10. A grade of 5 certifies the acquisition of minimum learning outcomes and the corresponding study credits. Conditions for promotion include knowing the characteristics of innovative entrepreneurship, legislative notions, and concepts related to initiating, protecting, planning, and managing a business.
